nodes.description: Boolean flag controlling whether the gambling/deflation mechanics are active in MultiplierToken.
Address of the ETH-X20 Uniswap liquidity pool; only transfers originating from this address can win the game reward.
Incrementing nonce used as part of the pseudo-random seed in _randModulus.
Owner-supplied random seed used by _randModulus and _play.
Derived random seed computed at startGame and used by _randModulus and _play.
Chance rate constant set to 100 when the game starts.
ERC20 total supply, modified by _mint and _burn.
ERC20 balance mapping, modified by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Ownable owner address used by the onlyOwner modifier.
owner-only initializer that sets liquidityPool, chanceRate and seeds, then flips gameStarted to true.
MultiplierToken override of ERC20 transfer that recomputes the amount through _getAmount (burn/reward).
MultiplierToken override of ERC20 transferFrom that recomputes the amount through _getAmount.
Public view returning the gameStarted flag.
Private helper that triggers reward payout, random burn and amount reduction when the game is active.
Private helper that mints 10x the amount to the recipient when the sender is the liquidity pool and _play wins.
Private helper computing the 1%-10% burn amount via _randModulus and division.
Public gambling function returning true when the two pseudo-random values are equal (1% chance).
Private pseudo-random generator combining nonce, seed, block.timestamp, block.difficulty and msg.sender.
MultiplierToken constructor minting the total supply to msg.sender and leaving the game stopped.
Internal ERC20 mint increasing _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Internal ERC20 burn reducing sender balance and _totalSupply.
Internal ERC20 transfer performing the balance bookkeeping and Transfer event.
Ownable onlyOwner function transferring the owner role to newOwner.
Ownable onlyOwner function setting the owner to the zero address.
Caller-controlled address used for randomization, minting, authorization checks and game entry.
now value used inside the pseudo-random generator, making the outcome miner-influenceable.
Pseudo-randomness derived from nonce, seed, now, block.difficulty and msg.sender - predictable/manipulable.
Burn-rate arithmetic amount.div(burnrate.add(10)) that can burn almost the whole transfer.
Uncapped reward mint amount.mul(10) granting a 10x payout to the winning recipient.
Win condition val1 == val2 built on operator-influenced pseudo-random values.
Subtraction amount.sub(burnAmount) applied after balance-modifying burn/mint in _getAmount.
_liquidityPool argument of startGame.
_seed1 argument of startGame.
recipient argument of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer.
amount argument carried through transfer, _getAmount, _sendReward and _getRandomBurnedAmount.
sender argument of transferFrom/_getAmount/_sendReward/_transfer.
mod argument (modulus) of _randModulus.
seed argument of _randModulus.
account argument of _mint/_burn.
newOwner argument of transferOwnership.
spender argument of approve.
Local burnAmount inside _getAmount.
Local burnrate inside _getRandomBurnedAmount.
Local val1 pseudo-random value inside _play.
Local val2 pseudo-random value inside _play.
Local rand result inside _randModulus.
Local msgSender captured in the Ownable constructor.
ERC20 approve setting the allowance of spender for the caller.

edges.reason: msg.sender is mixed into the keccak256 pseudo-random seed of _randModulus, so the caller influences the drawn value.
block.timestamp is part of the randomness input, making the outcome timestamp dependent.
msg.sender flows into the weak randomness operation.
block.timestamp flows into the weak randomness operation.
_randModulus executes the unsafe keccak256-based randomness construction.
startGame is protected by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() (msg.sender) against _owner.
transferOwnership authorization depends on msg.sender being the owner.
renounceOwnership authorization depends on msg.sender being the owner.
Constructor mints the total supply to the deploying msg.sender.
transfer passes _msgSender() into the transfer pipeline.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() for the allowance deduction.
approve sets the allowance of the caller (_msgSender()).
transfer calls _getAmount to compute the effective amount.
transferFrom calls _getAmount to compute the effective amount.
_getAmount calls _sendReward while the game is active.
_getAmount calls _getRandomBurnedAmount to derive the burn amount.
_getAmount burns the random amount from the sender balance.
_getAmount performs amount.sub(burnAmount) after state-changing burn/mint.
_sendReward calls _play to decide whether the sender wins.
_sendReward mints the reward to the recipient.
_sendReward mints amount.mul(10), an uncapped reward multiplication.
_getRandomBurnedAmount draws a random value from _randModulus.
_getRandomBurnedAmount divides amount by (burnrate+10) to obtain the burn amount.
_play draws two values from _randModulus.
_play compares the pseudo-random values to decide the winner.
startGame derives seed2 by calling _randModulus.
startGame writes gameStarted = true.
startGame writes the liquidityPool address.
hasGameStarted reads the gameStarted state variable.
_getAmount branches on the gameStarted flag.
_sendReward compares the sender against liquidityPool.
seed1 is part of the _randModulus randomness input.
seed2 is part of the _randModulus randomness input.
nonce is part of the _randModulus randomness input and is incremented there.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_transfer updates the _balances mapping.
transferOwnership reads and overwrites the _owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Transient argument used only by startGame to set the liquidityPool state variable.
Transient argument used only by startGame to set seed1 and derive seed2.
Caller-supplied recipient consumed by transfer/transferFrom before reaching _transfer.
Amount is recomputed (burned/reduced) inside _getAmount before the ERC20 transfer occurs.
Sender is forwarded into _getAmount/_sendReward where the burn and reward decisions are made.
Modulus argument only constrains the randomness output inside _randModulus.
Seed argument is folded directly into the keccak256 randomness input of _randModulus.
Account argument is the mint target inside the internal _mint routine.
newOwner argument is only used to reassign _owner in transferOwnership.
spender argument is only used to set the allowance inside approve.
Local burnAmount drives the _burn call and the amount.sub inside _getAmount.
Local burnrate is the divisor basis of the burn arithmetic in _getRandomBurnedAmount.
Local val1 is one side of the winning comparison in _play.
Local val2 is the other side of the winning comparison in _play.
Local rand is the keccak256-derived value produced inside _randModulus.
Local msgSender captured from _msgSender() initializes the owner, the same value checked in the onlyOwner-guarded transferOwnership.
